SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.position <= 10 THEN ps.points ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_points
FROM main.drivers d
JOIN main.results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN main.races rc ON r.raceId = rc.raceId
JOIN main.points_scheme ps ON r.positionOrder = ps.position
WHERE d.driverRef = 'button'
  AND rc.year = 2009
  AND rc.date < '2009-07-01'
  AND ps.authored = TRUE
  AND ps.scheme_id IN (
    SELECT scheme_id FROM main.points_scheme 
    WHERE authored = TRUE 
    AND '2011-03-01' >= '2011-01-01'  -- 假设 scheme_id 为当前生效的口径
    LIMIT 1
  )
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.position <= 10 THEN ps.points ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_points
FROM main.drivers d
JOIN main.results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN main.races rc ON r.raceId = rc.raceId
JOIN main.points_scheme ps ON r.positionOrder = ps.position
WHERE d.driverRef = 'button'
  AND rc.year = 2009
  AND rc.date < '2009-07-01'
  AND ps.authored = TRUE
  AND ps.scheme_id IN (
    SELECT scheme_id FROM main.points_scheme 
    WHERE authored = TRUE 
    AND '2011-03-01' >= '2011-01-01'  -- 假设 scheme_id 为当前生效的口径
    LIMIT 1
  )
